script:
title "NT Ladder: levelled within each band"
# The same five HCP bands as the ladder above, levelled one HCP at a time
# rather than one band at a time. Compare the HCP South histograms: levelling
# the bands alone leaves the inside of each as nature dealt it, so 12 comes up
# far oftener than 14. This is what LevelType_ is for.
#
# Snapshot of Practice-Bidding-Scenarios' NT_Ladder, with this note added.

# alias: NTLadder
# button-text: NT Ladder (Lev)
# scenario-title: --- NT Ladder (Lev)
# gib-works: true
# bba-works: true
# auction-filter: Auction.....\n[1-7]
# convention-card-ns: 21GF-DEFAULT
# convention-card-ew: 21GF-GIB

/*@chat
--- NT Ladder (Lev)
Practice balanced hand evaluation across the full NT opening range.
Five HCP ranges, leveled to:
• 12-14 HCP ({{level-mix:12_14}}) - Open 1 of a suit, then rebid 1NT
• 15-17 HCP ({{level-mix:15_17}}) - Standard 1NT opening
• 18-19 HCP ({{level-mix:18_19}}) - Too strong for 1NT, open 1x then rebid 2NT
• 20-21 HCP ({{level-mix:20_21}}) - Open 2NT
• 22-24 HCP ({{level-mix:22_24}}) - Open 2C then rebid 2NT
@chat*/

produce 5000
dealer south

# Balanced shape for South
balanced = shape(south, any 4333 + any 4432 + any 5332)

# Define HCP ranges
hcp12_14 = hcp(south) >= 12 and hcp(south) <= 14
hcp15_17 = hcp(south) >= 15 and hcp(south) <= 17
hcp18_19 = hcp(south) >= 18 and hcp(south) <= 19
hcp20_21 = hcp(south) >= 20 and hcp(south) <= 21
hcp22_24 = hcp(south) >= 22 and hcp(south) <= 24

# The five bands: what the deals are tagged, charted and interleaved by
HandType_12_14 = hcp12_14
HandType_15_17 = hcp15_17
HandType_18_19 = hcp18_19
HandType_20_21 = hcp20_21
HandType_22_24 = hcp22_24

# Level on each HCP, not on the band: levelling the bands alone leaves the
# inside of each as nature had it, and a 12 is far commoner than a 14.
# Shares keep the bands even while the values inside them are flat — a value in
# a two-wide band is wanted half again as often as one in a three-wide band.
LevelType_12 = hcp(south) == 12
LevelType_13 = hcp(south) == 13
LevelType_14 = hcp(south) == 14
LevelType_15 = hcp(south) == 15
LevelType_16 = hcp(south) == 16
LevelType_17 = hcp(south) == 17
LevelType_18 = hcp(south) == 18
LevelType_19 = hcp(south) == 19
LevelType_20 = hcp(south) == 20
LevelType_21 = hcp(south) == 21
LevelType_22 = hcp(south) == 22
LevelType_23 = hcp(south) == 23
LevelType_24 = hcp(south) == 24

LevelType_12_Share = 2      # 12-14, 15-17 and 22-24 are three HCP wide
LevelType_13_Share = 2
LevelType_14_Share = 2
LevelType_15_Share = 2
LevelType_16_Share = 2
LevelType_17_Share = 2
LevelType_18_Share = 3      # 18-19 and 20-21 are two
LevelType_19_Share = 3
LevelType_20_Share = 3
LevelType_21_Share = 3
LevelType_22_Share = 2
LevelType_23_Share = 2
LevelType_24_Share = 2

### BEGIN GENERATED LEVELING ###
noLeveling = 1
levelTheDeal = noLeveling
### END GENERATED LEVELING ###

##### Now do it #####
condition
balanced and hcp(south) >= 12 and hcp(south) <= 24
and levelTheDeal

action printoneline,
average "1. 12-14 HCP" 100 * hcp12_14,
average "2. 15-17 HCP" 100 * hcp15_17,
average "3. 18-19 HCP" 100 * hcp18_19,
average "4. 20-21 HCP" 100 * hcp20_21,
average "5. 22-24 HCP" 100 * hcp22_24,

frequency "HCP South " (hcp(south), 12, 24),
